تعطوا (form I)
# تَعُطُّوا (taʕuṭṭū) /ta.ʕutˤ.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of عَطَّ (ʕaṭṭa)
# تُعَطُّوا (tuʕaṭṭū) /tu.ʕatˤ.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of عَطَّ (ʕaṭṭa)
